policy: Everkai additions are characters that do NOT come from the original APK. They are shown only when the page is opened with ?crossover=1. Text is written for Everkai; art and clips are rendered by scripts/crossover/build-character.py from the owner's private MSF/SWGOH asset corpus. Each row borrows the progression tables (talent, Insight, skill guide, original growth) of its `template`, an original Fellow of the same rarity and type.

fellows.name: Spider-Man
fellows.title: Friendly Neighborhood Hero
fellows.description: A quick-witted wall-crawler who dropped into the village through a tear in the sky. He patrols the rooftops at dusk, trades jokes for directions, and never walks past someone who needs a hand.

fellows.name: Wolverine
fellows.title: The Quiet Trapper
fellows.description: Splits firewood before dawn and leaves a stack at whichever door needs it, then goes before anyone can thank him.

fellows.name: Captain America (WWII)
fellows.title: Drillyard Steward
fellows.description: Runs the morning drill on the green and will not let a recruit go home until their stance is right.

fellows.name: Iron Man (Infinity War)
fellows.title: The Lamp Wright
fellows.description: Rebuilt the village water pump in an afternoon and has been improving it, loudly, ever since.

fellows.name: Hulk
fellows.title: The Wall Mender
fellows.description: Carries the stones two carts could not, then sits out the afternoon in the shade of the wall he raised.

fellows.name: Thor (Infinity War)
fellows.title: Stormwatch Captain
fellows.description: Reads the sky for the harvest crews and calls the fields in before the first drop lands.

fellows.name: Doctor Doom
fellows.title: The Tower Tenant
fellows.description: Took the empty tower, filled it with ledgers, and answers questions only when the question is precise.

fellows.name: Magneto
fellows.title: The Iron Marshal
fellows.description: Keeps the foundry iron moving and speaks for the smiths whenever the village argues about wages.

fellows.name: Thanos (Endgame)
fellows.title: The Fallow Keeper
fellows.description: Thins the orchard without sentiment, and the trees he leaves standing carry twice the fruit.

fellows.name: Doctor Strange
fellows.title: The Doorway Scholar
fellows.description: Maps the paths that shift between the hills and posts a fresh chart at the crossroads each week.

fellows.name: Phoenix
fellows.title: The Ember Dancer
fellows.description: Tends the pottery kiln at its hottest hour, when nobody else will stand near it.

fellows.name: Loki
fellows.title: The Story Broker
fellows.description: Sells stories at the market, and one of them is always true, though never the one you paid for.

fellows.name: Black Panther
fellows.title: The Border Steward
fellows.description: Walks the boundary stones every dawn and settles land disputes before they reach the elder.

fellows.name: Deadpool
fellows.title: The Loud Neighbour
fellows.description: Takes any job nobody wants, finishes it oddly well, and narrates the whole thing to whoever is nearby.

fellows.name: Mister Fantastic (MCU)
fellows.title: The Bridge Fitter
fellows.description: Measures everything twice, builds once, and has already drawn a better bridge than the one he just finished.

fellows.name: Professor Xavier
fellows.title: The School Founder
fellows.description: Opened a classroom in the old grain store and teaches whoever turns up, at whatever hour they can come.

fellows.name: Silver Surfer
fellows.title: The Long Traveller
fellows.description: Rides ahead of the trade road and comes back with news a week before the couriers do.

fellows.name: Cyclops
fellows.title: The Head of Watch
fellows.description: Sets the watch rota and takes the coldest shift himself without mentioning it.

fellows.name: Daredevil (Modern)
fellows.title: The Night Listener
fellows.description: Walks the lanes after dark and hears trouble two streets before it starts.

fellows.name: The Thing
fellows.title: The Quarry Hand
fellows.description: Breaks stone all morning, complains about it all afternoon, and is back at the face before sunrise.

fellows.name: Venom
fellows.title: The Hungry Neighbour
fellows.description: Guards the village larder with unsettling devotion, and eats rather more of it than he admits.

fellows.name: Captain Marvel
fellows.title: The High Flyer
fellows.description: Carries urgent post over the ridge in an hour, a trip the road takes two days to make.

fellows.name: Human Torch
fellows.title: The Hearth Lighter
fellows.description: Lights every forge and oven in the village before breakfast and treats it as a personal contest.

fellows.name: Nick Fury
fellows.title: The Ledger Keeper
fellows.description: Knows who owes what to whom, and tells the elder only the parts that matter.

fellows.name: Doctor Octopus
fellows.title: The Many-Handed
fellows.description: Repaired the mill gearing with four wrenches at once and will not let anyone else touch it.

fellows.name: Green Goblin
fellows.title: The Rooftop Menace
fellows.description: Makes kites the children adore and the watch dislikes, and flies them where he should not.

fellows.name: Punisher
fellows.title: The Debt Collector
fellows.description: Recovers what was stolen, returns it to the door it came from, and never stays for the thanks.

fellows.name: Black Widow
fellows.title: The Careful Guest
fellows.description: Arrives at a negotiation already knowing what the other side means to ask for.

fellows.name: Namor
fellows.title: The Harbour Lord
fellows.description: Runs the village water channels and reminds everyone, often, whose water it is.

fellows.name: Star-Lord
fellows.title: The Tune Trader
fellows.description: Guides caravans over the pass and insists the whole crew sing on the climb.

fellows.name: Ant-Man
fellows.title: The Small Surveyor
fellows.description: Keeps the hives and can tell you the state of every comb without opening a single one.

fellows.name: Blade
fellows.title: The Dusk Warden
fellows.description: Takes the shift between midnight and dawn, the one nobody else volunteers for twice.

fellows.name: Gamora
fellows.title: The Sharp Gardener
fellows.description: Grows the difficult plants the apothecary needs and labels every pot twice.

fellows.name: Rocket Raccoon
fellows.title: The Gadget Hand
fellows.description: Fixes anything with a spring in it, charges too much, and is worth it.

fellows.name: Rogue
fellows.title: The Careful Touch
fellows.description: Calms every horse in the village, and wears gloves for reasons she has not explained.

fellows.name: Shang-Chi
fellows.title: The Morning Form
fellows.description: Runs the dawn training in the square and pairs the clumsiest recruit with himself.

fellows.name: Groot
fellows.title: The Orchard Keeper
fellows.description: Planted the lane of saplings by the school and waters them without being asked.

fellows.name: Hawkeye
fellows.title: The Steady Aim
fellows.description: Makes arrows for the archery range and quietly outshoots everyone who buys them.

fellows.name: Moon Knight
fellows.title: The Sleepless
fellows.description: Delivers the post at hours nobody asked for, and remembers none of it in the morning.

fellows.name: Beast
fellows.title: The Reading Room
fellows.description: Catalogued the whole reading room in a week and talks with anyone who takes a book out.

fellows.name: Gambit
fellows.title: The Card Sharp
fellows.description: Runs a card table at the market with terrible luck for everyone but himself.

fellows.name: Ghost Rider
fellows.title: The Road Warden
fellows.description: Patrols the night road and turns back whatever should not be on it.

fellows.name: Kingpin
fellows.title: The Big Landlord
fellows.description: Owns half the roofs on the lane and is unfailingly polite about the rent.

fellows.name: Ms. Marvel (Hard Light)
fellows.title: The Bright Helper
fellows.description: Volunteers for every village job at once and has not yet run out of enthusiasm.

fellows.name: She-Hulk
fellows.title: The Village Advocate
fellows.description: Hears disputes in the square and settles them with a clarity nobody dares appeal.

fellows.name: Vision
fellows.title: The Clock Mind
fellows.description: Keeps the village clock true to the second and rings it himself when the rope frays.

fellows.name: Adam Warlock
fellows.title: The Late Arrival
fellows.description: Turned up fully grown with no history and an unnerving talent for saying the useful thing.

fellows.name: Nightcrawler
fellows.title: The Chapel Step
fellows.description: Rings the chapel bell on time from wherever he happens to be standing.

fellows.name: Winter Soldier
fellows.title: The Long Memory
fellows.description: Keeps the watch gear sharp and oiled, and says less about where he learned to.

fellows.name: Cable
fellows.title: The Late Warning
fellows.description: Rides in with warnings that always turn out to have been worth listening to.

fellows.name: Colossus
fellows.title: The Iron Back
fellows.description: Carries roof beams up the ladder alone and apologises for taking the easy job.

fellows.name: Juggernaut
fellows.title: The Stopped Cart
fellows.description: Shifts loaded carts out of the mud by himself, then charges for the favour.

fellows.name: Mister Sinister
fellows.title: The Cold Study
fellows.description: Runs the clinic's back room, keeps immaculate notes, and unsettles the patients he cures.

fellows.name: Quicksilver
fellows.title: The Short Errand
fellows.description: Finishes the whole morning's errands before the market has finished opening.

fellows.name: Spider-Man (Miles)
fellows.title: The New Watch
fellows.description: Took the rooftop round nobody wanted and is better at it than anyone expected.

fellows.name: Black Bolt
fellows.title: The Silent Elder
fellows.description: Presides over meetings without saying a word, and the meetings go faster for it.

fellows.name: Hela
fellows.title: The Grave Warden
fellows.description: Tends the village graves, keeps the records, and is kinder at a funeral than anywhere else.

fellows.name: Luke Cage
fellows.title: The Steady Wall
fellows.description: Keeps the inn quiet with a look, and keeps the kitchen open for late arrivals.

fellows.name: Nova
fellows.title: The Young Patrol
fellows.description: Flies the ridge patrol and takes every extra shift he is offered.

fellows.name: Jubilee
fellows.title: The Bright Spark
fellows.description: Runs the festival lights and has not yet met a celebration she could not improve.

fellows.name: Sentry
fellows.title: The Bright Shadow
fellows.description: Stands the highest watch, and asks the elder each week whether he is still wanted there.

fellows.name: Kraven the Hunter
fellows.title: The Tracker
fellows.description: Tracks what takes the livestock and comes back with it, or with the reason.

fellows.name: Bishop
fellows.title: The Old Warning
fellows.description: Drills the watch as if the worst night is already scheduled, because he has seen one.

fellows.name: Drax
fellows.title: The Plain Speaker
fellows.description: Says exactly what he means, which the market has decided to find refreshing.

fellows.name: Ghost-Spider
fellows.title: The Second Rooftop
fellows.description: Shares the rooftop round, keeps her own hours, and beats the bell home every time.

fellows.name: America Chavez
fellows.title: The Straight Line
fellows.description: Goes from here to there by the shortest route in the world, whatever is in the way.

fellows.name: Kate Bishop
fellows.title: The Second Arrow
fellows.description: Runs the archery range, keeps the scorebook, and is always one point off the record.

fellows.name: X-23
fellows.title: The Short Answer
fellows.description: Patrols the treeline alone, reports in three words, and misses nothing.

fellows.name: Agent Coulson
fellows.title: The Steady Clerk
fellows.description: Keeps the village's paperwork in order and quietly keeps the village in order with it.

fellows.name: Electro
fellows.title: The Live Wire
fellows.description: Lights the lane lamps without a taper, and has been asked repeatedly not to show off.

fellows.name: Magik
fellows.title: The Cellar Door
fellows.description: Minds the old cellar door nobody else will go near, and knows what is behind it.

fellows.name: Mantis
fellows.title: The Gentle Hand
fellows.description: Grows the calming herbs and knows, before you speak, which one you came for.

fellows.name: Nebula
fellows.title: The Cold Count
fellows.description: Counts the stores twice a week and has never been out by a single sack.

fellows.name: Yelena Belova
fellows.title: The Dry Remark
fellows.description: Scouts the far road, reports accurately, and makes the reporting funnier than it needs to be.

fellows.name: Nico Minoru
fellows.title: The Bright Study
fellows.description: Copies the village records after school and has started correcting them.

fellows.name: Darth Vader
fellows.title: Duel's End
fellows.description: An armored warlord who arrived with his helmet cracked open from a fight long past. Villagers keep their distance, yet he lights the watchtower every night and says little about the road that led him here.

fellows.name: Jedi Knight Anakin
fellows.title: The Quick Blade
fellows.description: Teaches the sword too fast for most students and stays late with the ones who keep up.

fellows.name: Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker
fellows.title: The New Standard
fellows.description: Took command of the watch young, and the watch decided within a week that it was fine.

fellows.name: Han Solo
fellows.title: The Short Cut
fellows.description: Knows a faster road than the one on the map and is right about it more often than not.

fellows.name: Ahsoka Tano
fellows.title: The Patient Teacher
fellows.description: Trains the village's youngest recruits and refuses to let one of them quit early.

fellows.name: Darth Sidious
fellows.title: The Smiling Counsel
fellows.description: Advises the elder with immaculate courtesy, and the advice is always good for somebody.

fellows.name: Sith Eternal Emperor
fellows.title: The Long Shadow
fellows.description: Turned up when the elder was ill and has been indispensable in a way nobody likes.

fellows.name: Jedi Master Kenobi
fellows.title: The Old Lesson
fellows.description: Teaches patience to children and to adults, and has more success with the children.

fellows.name: R2-D2
fellows.title: The Little Engine
fellows.description: Maintains the well pumps, whistles while doing it, and has never let one fail.

fellows.name: Grand Master Yoda
fellows.title: The Small Master
fellows.description: Teaches the slow lessons in the garden and is older than the village records.

fellows.name: Chewbacca
fellows.title: The Strong Hand
fellows.description: Raises roof frames single-handed and takes payment in bread.

fellows.name: C-3PO
fellows.title: The Polite Clerk
fellows.description: Translates for every visiting trader and apologises constantly for their manners.

fellows.name: Supreme Leader Kylo Ren
fellows.title: The Hard Practice
fellows.description: Trains alone, hard, at the far end of the yard, and is civil to anyone who joins him.

fellows.name: Rey
fellows.title: The Scrap Finder
fellows.description: Brings back the broken things nobody wanted and makes half of them work again.

fellows.name: Darth Bane
fellows.title: The Old Grudge
fellows.description: Lives above the quarry, comes down for salt, and is best left to his own arrangements.

fellows.name: Darth Maul
fellows.title: The Split Temper
fellows.description: Fights at the festival bouts, wins, and is never once satisfied about it.

fellows.name: Grand Admiral Thrawn
fellows.title: The Cold Plan
fellows.description: Has already worked out how the village fails, and told the elder, politely, in writing.

fellows.name: Darth Revan
fellows.title: The Two Names
fellows.description: Came back from a long road with two sets of notes and will not say which is his.

fellows.name: Ben Solo
fellows.title: The Late Turn
fellows.description: Joined the watch late, works the hardest shifts, and is still proving something.

fellows.name: Boba Fett, Scion of Jango
fellows.title: The Fixed Price
fellows.description: Recovers strays and stolen goods for a stated fee, paid in advance, no negotiation.

fellows.name: Jabba the Hutt
fellows.title: The Fat Ledger
fellows.description: Owns the market stalls, rules them from a couch, and knows every debt on the square.

fellows.name: Jedi Master Mace Windu
fellows.title: The Last Word
fellows.description: Hears a case once, rules once, and has never been asked to rule twice.

fellows.name: Master Qui-Gon
fellows.title: The Slow Road
fellows.description: Teaches by walking the fields with a student until the student works it out.

fellows.name: The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)
fellows.title: The Kept Word
fellows.description: Escorts whoever needs escorting, says almost nothing, and has never lost a charge.

fellows.name: Count Dooku
fellows.title: The Fine Manner
fellows.description: Teaches the elegant forms, charges properly for them, and looks down on the cheap ones.

fellows.name: General Grievous
fellows.title: The Four Arms
fellows.description: Enters every festival bout, wins several at once, and coughs through the victory speech.

fellows.name: Lando Calrissian
fellows.title: The Smooth Deal
fellows.description: Sells the village's surplus for more than it is worth and everyone leaves happy.

fellows.name: Darth Malgus
fellows.title: The Heavy Hand
fellows.description: Knocks down what must come down, and is careful only about the parts that stay up.

fellows.name: Grand Moff Tarkin
fellows.title: The Straight Line
fellows.description: Runs the building works on schedule, to the day, and is disliked for it.

fellows.name: Bo-Katan (Mand'alor)
fellows.title: The Held Banner
fellows.description: Leads the watch, carries the old banner, and will not let the village forget its debts.

fellows.name: Darth Malak
fellows.title: The Iron Jaw
fellows.description: Breaks the hardest ground on the works and never asks for the lighter tool.

fellows.name: Darth Nihilus
fellows.title: The Empty Coat
fellows.description: Drifts through the village between harvests, eats little, and leaves the room colder.

fellows.name: Cassian Andor (Undercover)
fellows.title: The Plain Cloak
fellows.description: Comes back from the far towns with the news the couriers did not hear.

fellows.name: Darth Traya
fellows.title: The Hard Teacher
fellows.description: Teaches the lessons nobody thanks her for, and is usually proved right later.

fellows.name: Admiral Ackbar
fellows.title: The Old Signal
fellows.description: Runs the landing stage, calls every hazard early, and is never wrong about a tide.

fellows.name: Jedi Knight Cal Kestis
fellows.title: The Young Climb
fellows.description: Rigs the scaffolds and climbs the ones he does not trust himself.

fellows.name: Ezra Bridger (Exile)
fellows.title: The Long Absence
fellows.description: Left the village young, came back older than the years account for, and says little about it.

fellows.name: Resistance Hero Finn
fellows.title: The Willing Hand
fellows.description: Volunteers first, learns fast, and stays behind to put the chairs away.

fellows.name: Starkiller
fellows.title: The Hard Start
fellows.description: Works the quarry face like a man paying something off, and never says what.

fellows.name: Asajj Ventress
fellows.title: The Sharp Bargain
fellows.description: Takes the jobs the watch cannot, names her price, and keeps to the letter of it.

fellows.name: General Syndulla
fellows.title: The Steady Wing
fellows.description: Flies the village airship, keeps it airworthy, and never leaves a crew on the ground.

fellows.name: Sabine Wren
fellows.title: The Bright Paint
fellows.description: Paints the village signs and murals, and has improved several walls without being asked.

fellows.name: Jyn Erso
fellows.title: The Own Road
fellows.description: Takes the route she chose, reports what she found, and argues about the rest later.

fellows.name: Kanan Jarrus
fellows.title: The Blind Teacher
fellows.description: Teaches the class without looking at it and catches every note passed along the back row.

fellows.name: Resistance Hero Poe
fellows.title: The Loud Morning
fellows.description: Flies the ridge run, lands rough, and has the whole crew laughing about it by supper.

fellows.name: Saw Gerrera
fellows.title: The Hard Line
fellows.description: Drills the militia harder than the elder approves of, and the militia keeps turning up.

fellows.name: Luthen Rael
fellows.title: The Front Shop
fellows.description: Keeps a respectable curio shop and a back room the watch has never been shown.

fellows.name: BB-8
fellows.title: The Round Helper
fellows.description: Rolls the tools out to whichever crew shouted for them, and gets there first.

fellows.name: Grand Inquisitor
fellows.title: The Cold Question
fellows.description: Asks the questions the watch would rather not, and gets answers the watch needed.

fellows.name: HK-47
fellows.title: The Blunt Instrument
fellows.description: Guards the gate exactly as instructed and describes the job with unsettling enthusiasm.

fellows.name: Cad Bane
fellows.title: The Wide Hat
fellows.description: Comes for whoever skipped their debt, gets them, and is gone by the next morning.

fellows.name: Captain Rex
fellows.title: The Old Sergeant
fellows.description: Drills the watch by the book he helped write, and knows every name in the ranks.

fellows.name: Darth Sion
fellows.title: The Cracked Man
fellows.description: Fights the festival bouts held together by will, and keeps getting back up.

fellows.name: Kyle Katarn
fellows.title: The Hired Blade
fellows.description: Escorts caravans for a fair rate and stays for the drink afterwards.

fellows.name: Director Krennic
fellows.title: The Grand Plan
fellows.description: Runs the big build, takes the credit early, and somehow finishes it anyway.

fellows.name: IG-12 & Grogu
fellows.title: The Minded Pair
fellows.description: Walks the village children to school at a careful pace with one of them aboard.

fellows.name: Grogu & Anzellans
fellows.title: The Small Crew
fellows.description: A very small supervisor and a very busy crew, who between them fix everything on the lane.

fellows.name: Padawan Sabine Wren
fellows.title: The Second Brush
fellows.description: Paints alongside the sign painter after school and is catching up faster than expected.

family.name: Invisible Woman
family.title: Unseen Guardian
family.description: A steady newcomer who keeps the village calm when storms come in off the water. She reads by the window most evenings, mends what the children break without being asked, and would rather be useful than noticed.

family.name: Emma Frost
family.title: The White Tutor
family.description: She arrived in white with a trunk of books and opened a small reading room above the inn. Precise, unhurried, and warmer than she lets on once a conversation has earned her attention.

family.name: Agatha Harkness
family.title: Village Elder
family.description: The oldest cottage on the lane is hers, and so is the herb garden behind it. She remembers every name in the village, brews a tea for every complaint, and enjoys being underestimated.

family.name: Sersi
family.title: Stonewright
family.description: A sculptor who came for the local stone and stayed for the company. She turns quarry offcuts into garden figures, hums while she works, and finds ordinary village days genuinely lovely.

family.name: Scarlet Witch
family.title: Hearth Warden
family.description: She keeps the hearth charms above every door in the village and repairs them herself when the wind takes one. Quiet company, quick to worry about other people, slow to ask anything for herself.

family.name: Jean Grey
family.title: Quiet Listener
family.description: She listens more than she speaks, which is why half the village ends up telling her things. She keeps a garden bench free for whoever needs it and always seems to know when the kettle should go on.

family.name: Storm
family.title: Weather Reader
family.description: She reads the sky better than the almanac and tells the farmers when to cut and when to wait. Formal at first, wonderful at a festival, and fiercely loyal once she calls a place home.

family.name: Medusa
family.title: Visiting Queen
family.description: A visiting queen who asked for lodging like anyone else and pays her board on time. She braids her long hair differently for every occasion and takes the village’s small ceremonies very seriously.

family.name: Jessica Jones
family.title: Finder of Lost Things
family.description: She took the room over the tavern and the job nobody else wanted: finding what the village loses. Blunt, tired, dependable, and much kinder about it than her tone suggests.

family.name: Sharon Carter
family.title: Border Warden
family.description: She walks the boundary road at dawn and knows every cart that comes through. Practical company, good at plans, and privately relieved to be somewhere small enough to learn by heart.

family.name: Maria Hill
family.title: Village Organiser
family.description: Give her a muddle and she will hand you back a list. She keeps the storehouse ledgers, the festival rota and the repair queue, and complains about all three while doing them well.

family.name: Mockingbird
family.title: Hedgerow Mapper
family.description: A naturalist who maps the hedgerows and argues cheerfully with anyone about birds. She takes her notebook on every walk, and her walks are how most of her friendships start.

family.name: Black Cat
family.title: Night Cat
family.description: She turned up with a lockpick set and a talent for opening things people had given up on. Charming, a little smug, and unexpectedly gentle with anyone who trusts her first.

family.name: Mystique
family.title: Many Faces
family.description: The playhouse stood empty until she arrived; now it sells out. She plays every part herself, keeps her own history vague, and is easier company than her reputation promises.

family.name: Morgan Le Fay
family.title: Old-Road Scholar
family.description: A scholar of old roads and older markings, here to copy the standing stones above the valley. Grand in manner, curious in private, and delighted whenever someone asks her a real question.

family.name: Kitty Pryde
family.title: Wall-Reader
family.description: The youngest builder on the crew and the one who spots the fault in a wall first. Talks fast, works faster, and treats the village dog as a colleague.

family.name: Psylocke
family.title: Dawn Instructor
family.description: She cleared the old barn and turned it into a training floor open to anyone at dawn. Exacting about form, generous with her time, and calm in a way the village borrows from her.

family.name: Captain Carter
family.title: Shield of the Old War
family.description: She hung up the shield and took up the militia drill instead. Straight-backed, dryly funny, and quietly pleased that the hardest thing she does now is teach.

family.name: Thena
family.title: Ageless Guard
family.description: She keeps the forge company more than the tavern and mends tools nobody thought worth mending. Long silences, exact work, and a slow friendliness that lasts once it arrives.

family.name: Dagger
family.title: Lightbearer
family.description: She sits with the sick and the sleepless and leaves a light burning in the infirmary window. Softly spoken, stubborn about rest, and the first person anyone fetches at night.

family.name: Padmé Amidala
family.title: Village Voice
family.description: She speaks for the village at the market courts and comes home with better prices than anyone expected. Gracious, exact, and happiest at a table where everyone is heard.

family.name: Leia Organa
family.title: Harvest Chair
family.description: Put her in a room with a problem and she will chair it. She organises the harvest, the repairs and the arguments, and has never once let a promise slide.

family.name: Mon Mothma
family.title: Council Chair
family.description: She chairs the village council with a steady hand and a very long memory. Formal, fair, and surprisingly warm over tea once the minutes are closed.

family.name: Luminara Unduli
family.title: Patient Teacher
family.description: She teaches stillness at the hill shrine each morning to whoever climbs up. Patient beyond reason, sparing with praise, and a steady presence on a hard day.

family.name: Satele Shan
family.title: Keeper in Exile
family.description: A temple keeper in exile who sweeps her own steps and asks for no ceremony. Reserved, watchful, and unshakeable once she decides a place is worth protecting.

family.name: Bastila Shan
family.title: Battle Seer
family.description: She runs the sparring circle behind the inn and reads a bout three moves before it happens. Proud, quick to correct, and loyal to a fault to the people she trains.

family.name: Barriss Offee
family.title: Ward of the Infirmary
family.description: The infirmary is tidier since she came, and so are its records. She works late, forgets meals, and is gently immovable about everyone else’s recovery.

family.name: Mara Jade
family.title: Quiet Courier
family.description: She carries messages over the pass in weather nobody else will ride out in. Guarded about her past, easy about the present, and better company on a long road than in a crowd.

family.name: Aayla Secura
family.title: Grove Keeper
family.description: She keeps the grove beyond the orchard and the animals that live in it. Unhurried, direct, and the only person in the village the goats will obey.

family.name: Cara Dune
family.title: Crossroads Marshal
family.description: She keeps the peace at the crossroads gate and breaks up more arguments than fights. Broad humour, short patience for nonsense, and reliably first to help lift something heavy.
